findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_job_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Spend one credit to run a full search: 7 roles matched to the profile, each with a tailored CV and cover letter emailed to the account address. Requires an API key.
